t: A tiny AI chip with two brains and two AI helpers for smart cameras.
steps: Buy the OpenMV AE3 from the OpenMV store for about 150 US dollars.
Get a USB-C cable to connect it to your computer.
Install the OpenMV tools named on the OpenMV site.
Plug in the board and open a MicroPython camera example.
Run a color tracking or face detection example and watch the preview.
Try an object detection example that uses the NPUs.
Add a plug-in sensor through the Qwiic connector next.
meta: Open Board. From $150. A few stores.
